title: Published instrument to agency implementation custody

missing_requirements.completion_test: All implementing offices, delegations, versions, exceptions, overrides, recusals, dissent, and dispositions are source-addressed.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Published Federal Register metadata is not an internal implementation file.

missing_requirements.target_row: complete agency submission and inventory roster
missing_requirements.completion_test: Every required agency submission, non-submission, correction, and no-action row is preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A public workforce dataset is not an agency inventory submission.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Attributed office, author, reviewer, approver, effective date, supersession, and withdrawal are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A named agency or office is not personal motive, authorship, or coordination.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Observed implementation, exception, challenge, correction, and no-action outcomes are joined to the exact instrument version.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Publication of an instrument is not observed implementation or practical correction.

refusal_rule: A publication identifier may reconcile documents, but it cannot establish internal implementation custody or complete agency action and no-action rows.

title: Award, contract, or assistance instrument to condition-specific action

missing_requirements.completion_test: All contracts, assistance awards, modifications, terminations, and no-action rows under the contested condition are enumerated.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: USAspending aggregate counts or Grants.gov opportunities are not the covered-instrument universe.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Every certification, records request, referral, review, exception, sanction, declination, appeal, and no-action row is preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Award receipt is not certification, violation, liability, or enforcement.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Recipient, parent, contractor, subcontractor, awardee, and successor identities are resolved with effective dates.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Name similarity or shared programme participation is not legal-entity identity or relationship.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Condition-specific action, burden, correction, closeout, continuity, substitution, and no-effect rows are linked to the exact instrument.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: An opportunity or award announcement is not a post-award outcome.

refusal_rule: A public award identifier can reconcile instrument records only after the condition-specific covered universe and action ledger are complete.

title: Enforcement policy to complete action and no-action register

missing_requirements.completion_test: All referrals, complaints, certifications, records requests, routed matters, rejections, and no-action rows are enumerated.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A public reporting channel or initiative announcement is not the referral denominator.

missing_requirements.completion_test: All investigations, settlements, litigations, withdrawals, declinations, sanctions, and no-action rows are source-addressed.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Press releases are not a complete enforcement register.

missing_requirements.completion_test: The complete covered population, excluded population, and sector scope are preserved with effective dates.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: One named resolution or selected publication list is not prevalence or coverage.

missing_requirements.target_row: appeal, correction, and final disposition ledger
missing_requirements.completion_test: Challenges, appeals, remands, modifications, compliance, recurrence, and finality are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Settlement or investigation is not admission or final merits success unless the instrument states it.

missing_requirements.target_row: staffing, budget, timing, and recurrence denominator
missing_requirements.completion_test: Institutional capacity, timing, repeat actions, and no-action intervals are preserved without converting recurrence into coordination.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Repeated publication does not establish prevalence, common purpose, or coordination.

refusal_rule: Published enforcement artifacts remain selected outputs until the complete action, declination, withdrawal, appeal, and no-action register is recovered.

title: Review docket to final and practically effective correction

missing_requirements.completion_test: All filings, pleadings, sealed or restricted entries, dismissals, settlements, abandoned paths, and final dispositions are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A published decision index is not the complete docket.

missing_requirements.completion_test: The exact decision, instrument, evidence, criteria, and administrative record under review are joined to the docket.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A docket number alone does not identify the complete challenged action.

missing_requirements.target_row: final correction, compliance, and durability record
missing_requirements.completion_test: Remand implementation, payment, reinstatement, reevaluation, recurrence, and durability are observed.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Formal remand, dismissal, or settlement is not practical correction.

missing_requirements.target_row: access, cost, timing, and abandonment denominator
missing_requirements.completion_test: Filing access, representation, fees, delays, abandonment, and unavailable routes are measured across the eligible universe.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Existence of a formal route is not effective counterpower.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Comparable denied, dismissed, withdrawn, unfiled, and no-correction rows are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Published successful cases are not the correction denominator.

refusal_rule: A docket index can locate a review process, but it cannot establish merits, practical correction, accessibility, or denominator completeness.

title: Workforce aggregates to protected personnel decisions

missing_requirements.completion_test: A privacy-safe aggregate or authorized person-level roster includes promotion, tenure, retention, discipline, reassignment, separation, and no-action rows.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Public workforce aggregates are not protected personnel decisions.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Eligible comparators, decision criteria, stated reasons, exceptions, overrides, and decision custody are preserved under lawful access.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Public category membership or aggregate movement is not an individual comparator or reason.

missing_requirements.target_row: lawful appeal, correction, and outcome ledger
missing_requirements.completion_test: Grievance, MSPB, EEOC, FSGB, union, court, settlement, remedy, timing, and no-correction rows are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A published case report is not the complete protected correction denominator.

refusal_rule: Protected personnel joins remain unavailable to public substitution and require privacy-safe aggregate or otherwise authorized lawful access.

title: Base populations to affected, unaffected, and comparator rows

missing_requirements.completion_test: A source-explicit rule identifies every included, excluded, burdened, corrected, and no-effect person or entity row.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Formal categories are not observed affected rows.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Eligible unaffected, unselected, untreated, and alternative-path rows are preserved under the same time and scope rules.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Named litigants, awardees, or recipients are not the comparator population.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Join keys, effective dates, parent and successor rules, ambiguity holds, and refusals are explicit.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Name matching, shared programme presence, or repeated source appearance is not identity or relationship.

missing_requirements.target_row: burden, no-effect, recurrence, and substitution outcomes
missing_requirements.completion_test: Outcome windows include burden, no observed effect, recurrence, reversal, substitution, exit, and durability rows.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: An aggregate base universe is not a distributional outcome ledger.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Group definitions, eligibility, denominators, missingness, lawful privacy treatment, and correction routes are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Unequal observed outcomes alone do not establish motive, racial order, prevalence, coordination, or common purpose.

refusal_rule: Separate workforce, award, assistance, and audit universes cannot be joined until lawful affected and comparator predicates are complete.

title: Announced value or audit finding to realized recovery and continuity

missing_requirements.completion_test: Obligations, outlays, settlement amounts, payment dates, receivables, offsets, and nonpayment rows are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Announced value is not realized payment or recovery.

missing_requirements.target_row: complete clawback, repayment, loss, and no-recovery ledger
missing_requirements.completion_test: Clawbacks, repayments, write-offs, defaults, losses, waivers, and no-recovery rows are enumerated.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: An audit finding is not a realized recovery.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Replacement providers, transition costs, service continuity, exit, interruption, and no-substitution rows are preserved.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Programme termination is not successful substitution or continuity.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Corrective plans, milestones, verification, recurrence, performance, and durability are observed.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: A corrective-action plan is not completed correction.

missing_requirements.completion_test: Public contribution, private residual rights, data, IP, operating knowledge, enterprise value, and public recovery terms are explicit.
missing_requirements.refused_substitution: Public support or private gain alone does not establish extraction, favoritism, or common purpose.

refusal_rule: Settlement, award, and audit identifiers become recovery joins only after realized payment, loss, correction, substitution, continuity, and residual-rights rows are complete.
